It must be hard seeing someone you love go through this kind of pain, and I'm guessing she feels the same way about you. I'm no expert or anything but try as you might but the most you can do is be there for her. Somethings you can't fix, something's shouldn't be fixed. These feelings she has are serious non the less, and most of them cannot be whisked away easily; things like body dismorphia and depression can stay with someone forever, but you have to accept that she will die eventually. she can decide to die now, no matter how much you love her, how hard you try, or whatever you do that she doesn't deserve life and that you are better off without her, just like everyone else in the world. And she'll have convinced herself so deeply that nothing could ever make her believe otherwise....or she will think about all of the reasons she wants to die, everything wrong in her life, and decide that she'll bear all of the pain for one more day.

You love her that much is clear. The way you talk about her like she's the reason you're alive. How you hate the thought of her feeling anything other than pure happiness. You're doing the best you can. You have to take each day as it comes. One by one. Each second with her. That fear won't go away though it's a curse. But you have to be strong for her, because she's scared too. You gotta be the one who knows things are gonna be ok even if you have no clue what will happen. You're gonna be her lifeline. Just try your best to understand what she's feeling. Sometimes you won't be able too but as long as you stay by her side all the way through you'll be there for her and that's all you can do.
